_comment: Profiles: sign up and log in with a username, no password. The server owns the name rules (backend/services/profile.py) and hands back the spelling kept under 'storageKey'. The name travels on every /api/progress call in 'header', percent-encoded. 'refetch' are the react-query key heads that read progress, refetched when the user changes. Queries keyed by the username itself ('account') need no refetch.
